umash_unionfansub.name: UnionFansub
umash_unionfansub.author: Umash
umash_unionfansub.notes: Spanish anime fansubs. Sign in from Umash on the forum's own page, which signs you in to the tracker. Adult categories are left out when adult content is off. Built from Jackett's indexer and tested against the site signed out; not yet tried with a real account.

umash_xxxclub.name: XXXClub
umash_xxxclub.author: Umash
umash_xxxclub.notes: Adult. The 30 best-seeded results of a search. Reads the site's current pages.

umash_yggreborn.name: YggReborn
umash_yggreborn.author: Umash
umash_yggreborn.notes: French tracker that follows YggTorrent, through its API with the PassKey from the site's API guide page, kept in your Keychain. Result links carry no key. Built from Jackett's and Prowlarr's indexers; a made-up key gets a clear refusal, but no real account has tried it yet.

umash_yts.name: YTS
umash_yts.author: Umash
umash_yts.notes: Small-size movie releases, one result per quality (720p, 1080p, 2160p), up to 3 pages of 50 movies with magnets, in under a second. Tested against the live API. Uses YTS's public API at its new address, movies-api.accel.li, with the older yts.mx and yts.bz as fallbacks. No account needed. Movies only.

umash_zamunda.name: Zamunda.LIFE
umash_zamunda.author: Umash
umash_zamunda.notes: Bulgarian magnet search that replaced Zamunda.RIP. No account needed: 20 results a page, with Load More, and magnets. No seed counts or dates.
